plan: [Compute the Bayesian Nash equilibrium for a first-price sealed-bid auction with 3 bidders and values uniform on [0,49]. The symmetric equilibrium bidding function is b(v) = (n-1)/n * v = 2/3 * v. For my value v = 39, the equilibrium bid is 26.0. Use $0.1 increments; bidding 26.0 maximizes expected profit in the long run against similar opponents.]
